hooks.name: Import audit after saving a Python file
hooks.description: Keeps Cathodemon standard-library only: after the agent saves a .py file, it must run the import audit and fix anything it reports.

action.prompt: A Python file was just saved. Run `python scripts/audit_imports.py` now. If it reports a third-party import, a dynamic import, exec or eval, replace that code with standard-library code before doing anything else, then tell the owner what you changed. The own-code-only steering rules apply.
